name: Elizabeth Warren
subject: “Let her try, Polly.”
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Warren for Senate
body:
Warren for Senate: https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/370?source=em-header&t=1001&akid=2937%2E4032634%2Exx4egm

If Father’s Day today is hitting you hard, my heart goes out to you.

I’m wishing I could give my daddy a call.

After my mother died, I called him every night. Most weekends, we watched
sports together, with him in Oklahoma and me in Massachusetts. We called
back and forth on the phone after a really good (or bad) play.

I wanted to keep him company, and I wanted to hear his voice.

He taught me to dream big. He had big dreams of his own: He wanted to fly
airplanes. He was barely out of high school when he rebuilt a
two-passenger, open-cockpit airplane and taught himself to fly above the
prairies of eastern Oklahoma. I always pictured him landing and taking off
in vast wheat fields, a tiny plane in an immense blue sky.

He survived the double blows of the Dust Bowl and the Great Depression in
the small town where he grew up. Decades later, both my parents still
talked of bank failures and families who lost their farms during some of
the toughest times for our country.

By the time World War II came along, they already had three young boys.
Daddy tried to enlist to be a fighter pilot in the war, but the Army Air
Forces (as it was known then) said he was too old, or at least that’s the
explanation I heard.

When the war finally ended, he desperately wanted a job flying the new
passenger planes for one of the fast-growing airlines like TWA or
American. But that didn’t work out either. My mother told me that those
jobs also went to younger men.

So he moved from one job to another: He was a salesman, he fixed cars, he
ended up as a janitor. He liked working with his hands, doing repairs
around the house. And like a zillion other families, we got by.

When I was a senior in high school, I started thinking about college. I
wanted to be a teacher, and that meant I needed a college diploma. But my
mother said it was out of the question. She pointed out that we couldn’t
afford college, that she and Daddy just didn’t make enough money. Besides,
he’d had a heart attack, and now it took both of my parents’ paychecks to
manage.

I knew how much my parents sacrificed for my future and for my brothers’
futures, but I wanted to teach. It was my big dream, and I wouldn’t give
up.

My mother kept saying no, and we argued back and forth. Then Daddy
surprised both of us, saying: “Let her try, Polly.” And I was off and
running.

There were lots of bumps and wrong turns along the way. I got married at
19 (it didn’t work out). I moved. I dropped out of school. But eventually,
I made it.

Whatever I did, my daddy believed in me and my big dreams. He would say,
“That’s my Betsy."

In truth, I think he found it pretty miraculous that his baby girl had
ended up a teacher. He nearly busted his buttons the first time I was
quoted in the newspaper.

When he got sick, I came across a video series about the airplanes of
World War II. I bought all the videotapes and took them to him. I was sure
he would love seeing the old planes, that he would point out this or that
plane he remembered from the war. But the only thing he wanted to talk
about was how much he missed my mother.

For months — for years, actually — after he died, I would see or hear
something and think, Oh, I’ll tell Daddy about that. And then I’d get a
little jolt all over again. He was gone.

I would not be here if he hadn’t pushed open a door so that I could have a
chance. That is how this daughter of a janitor ended up as a public school
teacher, a law professor, and a United States senator. And our story isn’t
unique. Parents all across our country are working hard to give their
children the opportunities they themselves never had.

That kind of sacrifice — a sacrifice fueled by love — is why I’m in this
fight all the way. All of our children deserve a chance to succeed. And
all of our parents deserve the peace of mind of knowing their hard work
created a better future for their children and grandchildren. That is the
promise of America, and I’m fighting to make sure we keep that promise.

My daddy is gone, but I want to wish him a Happy Father’s Day anyway — and
to all the fathers, and father figures, who are trying their hardest to
give their children a strong future, setting the example every day of what
it means to care for the people you love.

Elizabeth

This week, I introduced the Find Our Families Act, which would require DHS to maintain an accurate and detailed online detainee locator system for anyone detained by ICE or CBP. | | | [](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.X6XUC7u8ppFLNtMO_55SZlNseb7gEYIOhm_EWnhzEOZKmTtnV3k2h4V2x_O3H7rdW2az5rgktBwzxQ8Ml9Wgkmv85qW-UsBonL4KRa0bcNqdICU6T3NBDdNIZG7w7wEW7MGfh8hirTPoGM_0p0Si77n5HjN5RO-be0M9FsPQsXaSr54b_Vw9l1PbZkS9Ohgf5sq3NC81WVHINurQz3SxGar1mYfT41WPS1Zemskzr6mqBhy0-KzdhtmIfJg7RfMZvF8HZ96rq2GuQoNpDxwC85U-CV5aQBad8Io0NHE41qfN89sBflauaVDTvgX439yd2j6uwKHhyE_h90HgCkKlNk0ASMoVCsnlmfAs8Eb4TQ8bPgznUz57PFojXXDnfv9g/4ro/42zVQCGXTuC6KiFzaYVPFA/h0/h001.4119OFbw5GOUAjmRB9IFNvEK9m15d-tWkMPquReOe-A)

Friend, **We’re demanding justice for people who’ve been detained by ICE and Border Patrol.** To stop the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) from disappearing our family members and loved ones, **I’ve introduced the**** _Find Our Families Act_****to require DHS to maintain an accurate, detailed, and up-to-date online detainee locator system.** We must hold these rogue, lawless agencies accountable and stop them from abducting and disappearing our neighbors and loved ones. Lawyers and family members have been left in the dark about where they were taken, or if they are even still in the United States. **The**** _Find Our Families Act_****would notify people’s families and legal counsel when they’re transferred for urgent medical care. subject: Why JD Vance’s story meant so much to Charlie Kirk
body:
A story of faith lost, tested, and found again | | | |
---
| | | Peter,
---
Faith is essential to the survival and success of America.

Charlie Kirk staked his life's work on that truth.

He went straight into the hardest places in our culture and said what too many others were afraid to say, even when the crowd was hostile and the odds were against him.

He understood that if America is going to be renewed, the next generation has to find its way back to faith, truth, and love of country.

That's one reason JD Vance's story meant so much to him: Charlie saw in the Vice President something rare in public life -- a man whose faith had been tested, shaken, and ultimately rebuilt.

**That journey is what JD Vance writes about in his new book,_Communion: Finding My Way Back to Faith._**

Peter, this book isn't just about JD Vance's story...

It speaks to something much bigger happening in our country right now.

So many Americans know what it feels like to live in a culture that is constantly pulling them away from what matters most -- away from faith, from family, and from the values that once held this country together.

Young people face that pressure every single day.

They're told faith is outdated. They're told truth is whatever feels right, or whatever the culture says it is.

JD Vance knows what it is like to live in that confusion.

He knows what it is like to search, to be shaped by a broken culture, and by God's grace, to find his way back.

That's what _Communion_ is about...

And it gets to the heart of what so many families are watching happen in the lives of their children and grandchildren right now.

That's why Turning Point USA is reaching young people where this battle is actually being fought -- on campuses, in classrooms, and in a culture that keeps pressuring them to walk away from faith.

Your support does far more than just send you a book...

It helps Turning Point USA reach young people in the very places where faith is under attack.

Because of supporters like you, students on more than 5,000 campuses are hearing something they may not hear anywhere else: a serious defense of faith, truth, and a life rooted in God.

For many of them, that's the first time anyone has challenged the lies they have been fed.

And for many of them, that's where their minds begin to change -- and so do their lives.

Charlie believed the next generation was worth fighting for.

He believed young people were not beyond reach -- they needed someone willing to meet them where this battle is being fought and tell them the truth clearly and directly.

That's why your support matters.

It helps Turning Point USA keep showing up. And it helps carry forward the mission Charlie gave his life to build.

I've been a brewer, a geologist, a mayor, a governor, and a U.S. senator. But by far the best job I've had is being a dad.

[ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/133744382/628924491/-1473932214?refcode=logo&amount=10&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83MjY1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4ZWYzNjUyMS04ZDZkLWYxMTEtOGZjYi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2ZDYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=NC385Uf7LiD0xehcaoWX_st2fmSh9eLU5SItAJ5r8qM=) **Happy Father’s Day, folks!** I’ve been a brewer, a geologist, a mayor, a governor, and a U.S. senator. But by far the best job I’ve had is being a dad.
_(On the left is an old photo of me and my oldest son Teddy, and on the right is baby Jack!)_ Being a dad to two extraordinary sons isn’t something I take for granted. My dad lost his battle with cancer and died when I was just eight years old. Like so many who have lost a parent, Father’s Day has always been bittersweet for me. But the chance to spend time with my boys isn’t something I’d miss. **Everything I do is for my sons and the hope that their future will be better than the division we’re living through today.** My dad used to call us kids his jewels. Now that I’m a father, I get what he meant. I'm the luckiest dad in the world, and I am so blessed to watch my boys grow up. Happy Father's Day to all the fathers and father figures. It’s the best job in the world! \- John

| | Dear Fellow American,

Winston Churchill once described Russia as "a riddle, wrapped in a mystery, inside an enigma"--words that still ring true.

But given Russia's ongoing war with Ukraine--and Russia's role in the shifting balance of power in today's world--a better understanding of Russia is critical.

Since Peter the Great, Russia's place among nations has only grown. As it transformed itself from a regional backwater to a great power, its politics and culture influenced significant events in our own history from the American Revolution to today.

And during the Cold War period between World War Two and the fall of the Soviet Union in 1991, American-Russian relations became the focus of world attention.

**The need for a better understanding of post-Cold War Russia, in light of its current importance and its long history as one of the world 's great powers, is why Hillsdale College has created a [FREE online video series on Russia](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/s/c/p9PT9H7tiab8mYkG_0ArGP9ktiotaTnu-1wRRL_pS0Hc4KdCIhcdf4x7-H4Ub0ycnLsmfzSMz62ML0SiQ9owHUd0sh62i4jdCxBZQUEij2Kf46Be_7-af6ObzHQNWgqrn1yD5DPm1bDsDMs2p-CEKyY4jefz0mlYzUV11aqnGelr_jQwIfXV4_vEIgo14J8-EOMSP882YviLqZvEvBDhQOkvacsoYpuGj8OAqwsQntrDTsK6fiDrEhL3Ml7acV6etHuJ4hkF22aeKXpNqvfY_WTNUz5ZHF-WYXoFDIIKaXOof3EYM-koc6gHhWRqAWumJIpdSRP7tYaAhgtMsPSuvgtVd1fPd9brlFhvhUa2m_VlIsjry-8eS1Hv_RFL7INt5UQL-qAQIvH4nhv1w5GwSAyrCOL6nd07BxgMtD5JdvuzeAxsbJSP1YwW7HFtvhBEENhSW_grVsYsKCcBiY0Mr8I0AJkI9H6q-ZhxbbxTPgAWYPrJDSnBh_-04TMp7CpWB4hqPBl8vk5diyew3WpfABaUgF6eU1Gfhy4ctwIEGq3qmSa_N1kSmVMQzkMxtmjk14tnsml4RHdb2vlS_ZpvssGdHVonVn5SG5252923glmTDSkOLA1pr7989F1kUEBc_TsImru-t0JYHi0etTb5OXF7u8AAb3kn4WDtnHEByle8p9Ap3Ej5FMo/tgI9HrJNUmQXTjosQSwhwsjnlqhMRd6z/21). **

In our online video series, based on a conference held at Hillsdale College, you'll learn more about Russian history--with special attention to the period from the Russian Revolution through the fall of the Soviet Union.

The video series also explores Russia's significant contributions to literature, through such authors as Dostoyevsky and Tolstoy, and to classical music, through such composers as Tchaikovsky and Rachmaninoff.

**You 'll also gain a deeper understanding of Russia's relationship with the West today, and about the causes and complications of the current Ukraine war. **

[https://info.hillsdale.edu/russia-cca-fye26](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/s/c/2NpHPOmyMEnDHTI6DeUThW9aTSodaGOD2WDPFZYG6ZWtOIEKNBnldkDPeflbDcCqcN6q61PuMkhxW0hDHQnGgiBO7vVCWVRhM6yQ_Td8bBp4uA9qHTeQCDqGWT7wkYBYyiBnTIL62y_QpJxEBtIWB5NASABVJwtmGVpvRi6GWbF29__GuVGRKHP5vQUduuvBG72OtAEayKu4u1QragYmWfLdOPLNUXoASrCBz0o8GCanCHXEIk4CydkP5-fRT6tFCSR5iA9zjOIw71a_RgKwczV0wkge9zdzVshRhkrTqO-BTcnfQzjw2GO4uRBxE5zbQhsNCGDkGYg3m_Foo9WcIfX_gISohr4J0VJf4_7Be41VI4dqO0R94qKUllEfqGcRbNpwWpl3Y8-nyFXminuTSBxtVci426B1ne_VJlU5PrDdotOh4gZkEHpbHX_fHGRO7yUUZxhilnlGVlfPGZOskxDp3_ANZoMZmOSN8MWtIF7uZ5EQpB1CfU1rOSFXTU0bil2aYkOk1Je_LIgt5AC0gmPmt5vUQ4xMB_3lCXmFyGZdgZ0vfwzjxd5HMRSTw4ues5KNkrz-0SWAsZxPdoo42DLKy2YQI8lnquCYOI8y3E5J58IP5u9J2oNt_So910CsE-xZ540JgPJuQ-W2CMhJCxqqFbrcso1l8O_KXtWItObSv28Y-OohLBA/KnQG-Ngy3JTiy9dvP3KSd7KHlvQWj4Op/21)

As it transformed itself from a regional backwater to a great power, its politics and culture influenced significant events in our own history from the American Revolution to today. And during the Cold War period between World War Two and the fall of the Soviet Union in 1991, American-Russian relations became the focus of world attention. The need for a better understanding of post-Cold War Russia, in light of its current importance and its long history as one of the world 's great powers, is why Hillsdale College has created a . In our online video series, based on a conference held at Hillsdale College, you'll learn more about Russian history--with special attention to the period from the Russian Revolution through the fall of the Soviet Union. The video series also explores Russia's significant contributions to literature, through such authors as Dostoyevsky and Tolstoy, and to classical music, through such composers as Tchaikovsky and Rachmaninoff. You 'll also gain a deeper understanding of Russia's relationship with the West today, and about the causes and complications of the current Ukraine war. subject: Does this seem “impartial” to you?
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY LEADERS WE DESERVE, LEADERSWEDESERVE
body:
The Democrats are doing the very same thing they booted me over.
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20260621-1&t=1&akid=3623%2E587540%2E1J1NgE)
Peter, I want to make sure you saw this, because it really pisses me off:
**The Democratic establishment is now doing the very same thing the DNC booted me over.**
The biggest contention during my time as DNC Vice Chair was that Leaders We Deserve was endorsing primary challengers in safe blue districts.
They said that the Party needed to remain impartial rather than getting involved.
Fast forward to now: the DCCC, a committee partially funded by the DNC, meddled in the primary in California’s 22nd District, backing the more conservative candidate, Jasmeet Bains, over our Leaders We Deserve-endorsed candidate Randy Villegas.
[](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260621_1_dccc.HXfheC&refcode=em20260621-3623&amount=5&t=2&akid=3623%2E587540%2E1J1NgE)
The Party’s efforts were unsuccessful — thanks in part to the support of this team. We helped Randy Villegas surge to victory despite the DNC. And we showed the Party that we won’t allow them to blunt the power of the next generation of leaders.
Because of this grassroots team, we’re able to compete against the massive warchest of the Democratic establishment when they try to beat our candidates.

name: Chaz Molder
subject: Being a dad is the best thing I have ever done.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Molder for Congress
body:
It’s also the reason I am running.

| | | | |
---
Hi Peter,
Father's Day has me feeling grateful.
Grateful for my three kids, who make me want to be better every single day. Grateful for Liz, who is the kind of mother who makes everything possible and who I could not do any of this without. And grateful for my own dad, who shaped me in ways I am still discovering. He is the one who taught me to lead with a gentle voice, and that decency still matters. He’s the Sunday School teacher for many decades who taught me what it means to be a person of faith, a Christian, and a lifelong member at the local Methodist church in Columbia. I am proud to be a dad, and I am proud to be his son.

Happy Father’s Day! Today, I’m grateful for my dad, for my husband, and for the dads, grandfathers, and uncles who support our kids and provide a foundation for our communities.

My dad taught me to listen and think critically. He taught me there are two sides - usually more - to every argument. I vividly remember sitting at our kitchen table talking about spotted owls and the logging industry. Those conversations taught me how to ask hard questions and look for common ground. And that there’s rarely an easy answer.

My dad showed me the value of hard work and responsibility. I remember being little and my dad leaving for the bus stop each morning and coming back home at night. On the way into the house he always listened to what I had to say about the day and entertained my questions and curiosity.

Father’s Day reminds me that so much of what keeps our communities strong comes from steady, mundane acts of care and love. Those contributions don’t make headlines, but they make a huge difference.

Wishing you a beautiful day with the people you love,

Paige

We’re nearly there ... but not quite all the way.
| | Hi there, Peter – did you get my invitation?
---
Yesterday, I reached out about a goal I set to add another 25,000 General Election Founding Donors to our campaign before the end of this month. I personally asked you to be one of them.
With just nine days left in the quarter, thousands of folks have already donated to join this special group. I’m thrilled to say we’re nearly there ... but not quite all the way.
**Will you pitch in any amount to become the newest member of our General Election Founding Donor team? Here’s the best link for you to use:[secure.actblue.com/donate/cooper/foundingdonor](https://act.roycooper.com/go/11942?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk693&t=6&akid=1851%2E124072%2Ej4FwP1)**
Thank you,
Roy Cooper

From: **Roy Cooper (via Cooper Victory Fund)**
Date: Sat, Jun 20, 2026
Subject: Peter, I want you on this team

| | |

[](https://act.roycooper.com/go/8283?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk693&source=&t=7&akid=1851%2E124072%2Ej4FwP1)
Peter,

Since March, thousands of folks have chipped in to become General Election Founding Donors to our campaign. That support has given us the ability to reach voters across the state and stay competitive in this race – and I’m so grateful.
However, our campaign’s ability to successfully fight back against the GOP hinges on people like you joining them.
**So today, I have to ask:[Can you please chip in $5 now to become a General Election Founding Donor and join the fight to flip this battleground Senate seat?](https://act.roycooper.com/go/11942?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk693&amount=5&t=8&akid=1851%2E124072%2Ej4FwP1)**

With experts in agreement that the pathway to Senate control runs right through NC, Republican super PACs so far are spending nearly $100 million (more than anywhere else in the country) to defeat me.
From here on out, the fight will only get harder as the attack ad buys get higher – and mark my words: **This isn’t the last of the dark money we’ll see.**
My only chance at fighting back against this outsized spending is by reaching every single grassroots fundraising target between now and Nov. 3. I can’t do that unless folks like you take your support of my campaign to the next level and chip in today.

name: Aaron Ford
subject: Happy Father’s Day, friend
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the Committee to Elect Aaron Ford
body:
# [](https://act.fordfornevada.com/go/12?t=1&akid=328%2E127862%2Eq64esI)
Today, I’m thinking about my boys.
Friend, when I was 21 years old, I became a single dad — two months before I was supposed to leave for a year-long study abroad program. I didn't know how I was going to do it. I just knew I had to.
[](https://act.fordfornevada.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_af_20260621_1_ak.Spxf1B&amount=5&refcode=em20260621-318&t=3&akid=328%2E127862%2Eq64esI)
I applied for Section 8, WIC, and food stamps to support my son and stay afloat while finishing up my degree. Medicaid ensured that my son and I were both able to see doctors and stay healthy. _These programs were a game-changer for us._
I went on to earn two master’s degrees, a law degree, and a PhD. I met my amazing wife, Berna, and together, we built a family.
[](https://act.fordfornevada.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_af_20260621_1_ak.Spxf1B&amount=5&refcode=em20260621-318&t=4&akid=328%2E127862%2Eq64esI)
One of our boys is a doctor now. Another is in law school. **I’m the proudest dad out there.**
As I look at my sons, I think about everything — the programs, the teachers, the neighbors — who supported them along the way.
That’s the same spirit and hope that’s fueling this campaign.
Every parent in Nevada deserves the same fighting chance I got. Every kid deserves a real shot at a future. But right now, MAGA Gov. Joe Lombardo is standing in the way — vetoing bills that would lower costs and letting Trump dismantle the programs that hold Nevada families together.
**I'm not doing this for the limelight. I'm doing it because somebody has to. And I've been fighting my whole life — I'm not about to stop now.**
If there's one thing I'd ask for this Father's Day, it's this: **[chip in $5 and help me make sure every Nevada family gets the same opportunities I got.](https://act.fordfornevada.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_af_20260621_1_ak.Spxf1B&amount=5&refcode=em20260621-318&t=5&akid=328%2E127862%2Eq64esI)**
**[Donate $5 ››](https://act.fordfornevada.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_af_20260621_1_ak.Spxf1B&amount=5&refcode=em20260621-318&t=24&akid=328%2E127862%2Eq64esI)**
Happy Father's Day to every dad out there doing the work.
With gratitude,
Aaron

name: Mark Pukita, GFI and Ohio Common Ground
subject: Why I'm Launching Ohio Common Ground
body:
Find out the vision for Ohio Common Ground. | | | [ ](https://us.list-manage.com/TXGCRhpl3rs?e=5c740fa3e2&c2id=1f0c5f5bfb3eed64dabb82bb1f157f37)
---
|
---
| Friends,

First, thank you for being part of the Grassroots Freedom Initiative.

Since 2019, many of us have invested countless hours trying to reform the Ohio Republican Party. Our requests were simple: no endorsements in contested primaries, no secret ballots, public meetings, and bylaws that give grassroots members a real voice.

After seven years, we've seen little meaningful reform and a consistently dismissive attitude from those in control.

I've reached a difficult conclusion: the Ohio Republican Party cannot be meaningfully changed from the inside.

Rather than continue fighting that battle, I've decided to focus on something different.

That's why I've launched [**Ohio Common Ground**](https://us.list-manage.com/mB9uN1uPC5v?e=5c740fa3e2&c2id=1f0c5f5bfb3eed64dabb82bb1f157f37).

[**Ohio Common Ground**](https://us.list-manage.com/16E49yNKJUi?e=5c740fa3e2&c2id=1f0c5f5bfb3eed64dabb82bb1f157f37) is not a political party. It is a statewide organization focused on organizing independent, unaffiliated, and politically frustrated Ohioans into a voter bloc large enough that politicians from both parties must listen.

Our focus is not ideology. It's giving voters more leverage and a stronger voice on issues that affect everyday Ohioans, including affordability, property taxes, housing, government accountability, election competition, and the future of our communities.

The question is no longer how to reform a political party.

The question is how to organize voters so politicians have to earn their support.

I believe [**Ohio Common Ground**](https://us.list-manage.com/63GiD6R6cVR?e=5c740fa3e2&c2id=1f0c5f5bfb3eed64dabb82bb1f157f37) is the answer.

I invite you to take a look and, if you like what you see, join us.

Please visit [**Ohio Common Ground**](https://us.list-manage.com/Qw9SYVu3ieN?e=5c740fa3e2&c2id=1f0c5f5bfb3eed64dabb82bb1f157f37) and consider coming on board us.

Thank you again for everything you've done through GFI. I hope you'll consider joining us as we take this next step.

Sincerely,

Mark Pukita
Founding Organizer, [**Ohio Common Ground**](https://us.list-manage.com/799W18qaYl4?e=5c740fa3e2&c2id=1f0c5f5bfb3eed64dabb82bb1f157f37)

name: Andrew Friedson
subject: This Father's Day is different
body:
I hope to live up to my dad’s values and carry his legacy forward to make Montgomery County a better place – for my daughter, for all our children, and grandchildren.

| Peter,

This Father's Day feels different for me.

It’s my first Father's Day as a dad myself, and the second one since losing my own dad unexpectedly, the night after Father’s Day two years ago.
---
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/133750241/628943368/-1721553747?refcode=BLU_EM_AFMC_2026-06-21_1&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDEvMS82MTY3OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhNjFlMTVlOC1hMDZkLWYxMTEtOGZjYi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2ZDYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=wur4gWPlIU3d1ep-faDAiUpZc8X-pQSkmZGxOJGErWI=)
It breaks my heart that he isn’t here with us to watch Joelle grow, but it fills my heart back up knowing that she carries his blessed memory in her name, along with his values, his example, and his love.

My dad believed deeply in service, community, and treating people with dignity and respect. He taught me that leadership isn't about titles or recognition. It's about showing up, using what you have and doing what you can to help others, and leaving your community better than you found it.

Those lessons continue to guide me every day. They shape how I approach public service, how I think about our community, and how best to serve it.

I carry my dad with me every day of this campaign – his values, his example, his commitment to making our community a better and more inclusive place. I am running with my dad, for my daughter, and for all of our children, and grandchildren, to ensure we are building a better, stronger county that lives up to our potential and provides more access and opportunities for them to live and thrive.

I hope to live up to my dad’s values and carry his legacy forward to make Montgomery County a better place – for my daughter, for all our children, and grandchildren.

clean_body: I hope to live up to my dad’s values and carry his legacy forward to make Montgomery County a better place – for my daughter, for all our children, and grandchildren. | Peter, This Father's Day feels different for me. It’s my first Father's Day as a dad myself, and the second one since losing my own dad unexpectedly, the night after Father’s Day two years ago. = It breaks my heart that he isn’t here with us to watch Joelle grow, but it fills my heart back up knowing that she carries his blessed memory in her name, along with his values, his example, and his love. My dad believed deeply in service, community, and treating people with dignity and respect. He taught me that leadership isn't about titles or recognition. It's about showing up, using what you have and doing what you can to help others, and leaving your community better than you found it. Those lessons continue to guide me every day. They shape how I approach public service, how I think about our community, and how best to serve it. I carry my dad with me every day of this campaign – his values, his example, his commitment to making our community a better and more inclusive place. I am running with my dad, for my daughter, and for all of our children, and grandchildren, to ensure we are building a better, stronger county that lives up to our potential and provides more access and opportunities for them to live and thrive. I hope to live up to my dad’s values and carry his legacy forward to make Montgomery County a better place – for my daughter, for all our children, and grandchildren. To everyone celebrating, remembering, or missing a dad or father figure today, I'm thinking of you. Happy Father's Day, = | | = * | | = By Authority: Friends of Andrew Friedson, Rose Hacking, Treasurer Friends of Andrew Friedson PO Box 2562 Rockville, MD 20847 United States | =

Peter,

This June, we celebrate Pride Month, a time to celebrate the culture and resilience of the LGBTQ+ community.

| | Peter,
---
I'm going to be blunt with you.

We are closer to losing this country than most people are willing to admit.

Not someday. Not "if things keep going this way."

Right now.

And the scariest part?

It's not happening in Washington. It's happening in classrooms.

High schools. Colleges.

Places where the next generation is being shaped -- or more accurately... reshaped.

If you've ever looked at what's coming out of our schools and thought: _" What happened to this country?" _

You're not wrong. You're seeing it clearly.

Because while most people are arguing online... while they're hoping things will turn around... while they're waiting for the next election to fix everything...

The other side is doing something far more dangerous.

They're raising the next generation.

Earlier. Faster. And with zero resistance in most places.

That's how countries are lost.

Slowly. Then all at once.

But here's the thing that should give a patriot like you hope...

There is one place where that trend is actually being challenged.

_And it shouldn 't even exist. _

**Just one year ago, Turning Point USA 's high school program -- which is now called "Club America" -- was in about 1,200 schools.**
That alone felt like a miracle.

Because starting even ONE chapter today takes courage most adults don't have.

Conservative students get mocked. Targeted. Threatened. Shut down.

And yet...

_They stepped up anyway. _

About that time, Charlie called me.

He didn't sound optimistic... He sounded urgent.

"Andrew, we've got to move faster."

I told him we were. He stopped me.

"No. You're not thinking what I'm thinking. I want to be in 35,000 high schools."

I actually laughed.

"Charlie... there aren't even 35,000 high schools in America."

"Okay," he said. "How many are there?"

"About 27,000."

And without hesitation: "Good. Let's do 27,000."

I remember sitting there thinking to myself... we're barely in 1,200 schools.

We didn't have the staff. We didn't have the infrastructure. We didn't even have the roadmap yet.

But Charlie wasn't fazed.

_" We'll figure it out." _

That was him.

He didn't wait for perfect conditions.

Because he knew something most people don't want to face: If we wait... _we lose everything. _

And now?

Less than a year later...

**We 're in 3,300 schools. **

**Thirteen percent of all high schools in America. **

**Eight states are now backing this effort to put a Club America chapter in every high school statewide. **

_That shouldn 't be possible. _

Not in this environment. Not with the level of hostility these students face every single day.

And yet... it's still happening.

_But Peter, here 's the part you need to understand: _

This is not a victory. It's a foothold.

_Because in the other 87% of schools? _

There is no resistance. None.

Just one-sided propaganda from the Left.

One-sided pressure on kids who are too young to even realize what's happening to them.

That's the reality.

The question isn't whether we're fighting. We are.

The question is whether it's enough.

Because right now, the students stepping up through Club America...

They're not the majority. _They 're the exception. _

They're the ones willing to take the heat.

The ones willing to stand alone.

The ones willing to risk being targeted just to say: _" I love this country." _

We have a choice.

Back them. _Or leave them on their own. _

**Because when a student starts a chapter, we send them an activism kit -- with American flags. Pocket Constitutions. Leadership tools. **

Everything they need to actually stand their ground.

Not symbolically. For real.

They've already made the decision to lead.

All they're waiting on... is you and me.

**Each activism kit costs $25. That 's it. **

$25 to make sure one student doesn't have to stand alone against the Left in a hostile school.

$25 to put real tools in their hands.

$25 to push back -- even if it's one campus at a time.

Club America isn't slowing down. It's accelerating.

Because every day, more students are stepping forward.

Not because it's easy or popular...

_But because they know what 's at stake. _

They're starting chapters in schools where they were told not to.

They're speaking truth in classrooms where the Left once went unchallenged.

They're choosing courage in places designed to make them conform.

And they're not alone.

They're finding each other. They're bringing more students with them every day.

They're building something real -- rooted in faith and freedom, grounded in truth, and unafraid to say that America is worth defending.

clean_body: I debated sending this... until now | | | | | Peter, I'm going to be blunt with you. We are closer to losing this country than most people are willing to admit. Not someday. Not "if things keep going this way." Right now. And the scariest part? It's not happening in Washington. It's happening in classrooms. High schools. Colleges. Places where the next generation is being shaped -- or more accurately... reshaped. If you've ever looked at what's coming out of our schools and thought: " What happened to this country?" You're not wrong. You're seeing it clearly. Because while most people are arguing online... while they're hoping things will turn around... while they're waiting for the next election to fix everything... The other side is doing something far more dangerous. They're raising the next generation. Earlier. Faster. And with zero resistance in most places. That's how countries are lost. Slowly. Then all at once. But here's the thing that should give a patriot like you hope... There is one place where that trend is actually being challenged. And it shouldn 't even exist. Just one year ago, Turning Point USA 's high school program -- which is now called "Club America" -- was in about 1,200 schools. That alone felt like a miracle. Because starting even ONE chapter today takes courage most adults don't have. Conservative students get mocked. Targeted. Threatened. Shut down. And yet... They stepped up anyway. About that time, Charlie called me. He didn't sound optimistic... He sounded urgent. "Andrew, we've got to move faster." I told him we were. He stopped me. "No. You're not thinking what I'm thinking. I want to be in 35,000 high schools." I actually laughed. "Charlie... there aren't even 35,000 high schools in America." "Okay," he said. "How many are there?" "About 27,000." And without hesitation: "Good. Let's do 27,000." I remember sitting there thinking to myself... we're barely in 1,200 schools. We didn't have the staff. We didn't have the infrastructure. We didn't even have the roadmap yet. But Charlie wasn't fazed. " We'll figure it out." That was him. He didn't wait for perfect conditions. Because he knew something most people don't want to face: If we wait... we lose everything. And now? Less than a year later... We 're in 3,300 schools. Thirteen percent of all high schools in America. Eight states are now backing this effort to put a Club America chapter in every high school statewide. That shouldn 't be possible. Not in this environment. Not with the level of hostility these students face every single day. And yet... it's still happening. But Peter, here 's the part you need to understand: This is not a victory. It's a foothold. Because in the other 87% of schools? There is no resistance. None. Just one-sided propaganda from the Left. One-sided pressure on kids who are too young to even realize what's happening to them. That's the reality. The question isn't whether we're fighting. We are. The question is whether it's enough. But because they know what 's at stake. They're starting chapters in schools where they were told not to. They're speaking truth in classrooms where the Left once went unchallenged. They're choosing courage in places designed to make them conform. And they're not alone. They're finding each other. They're bringing more students with them every day. They're building something real -- rooted in faith and freedom, grounded in truth, and unafraid to say that America is worth defending. That's how movements are built. Not from the top down... name: Dr. Mohamed El-Sayed
subject: Abdul was an amazing kid
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Abdul for U
body:
[ https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/1219?t=1001&akid=2412%2E251025%2EWZODM5 ]Abdul for US Senate [ https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/1219?t=1002&akid=2412%2E251025%2EWZODM5 ]Abdul for US Senate

Hi Peter, it’s Dr. Mohamed El-Sayed, Abdul’s dad. I wanted to wish
you all a Happy Father’s Day, and tell you a story about what a union
taught me, and how that shaped the values I passed on to Abdul.

Peter, I teach
mechanical engineering at Eastern Michigan University. I also served as
president of the faculty union.

During that period, the university administration lost touch with reality.
They stopped remembering that a university exists for students and
learning, and started focusing on privatizing everything.

So, we as a faculty went on strike.

[ Prof. ]Prof. Mohamed on strike. He's holding up a sign that says 'SETTLE THE
CONTRACT'

Soon after, I was sued for striking, being president of the union.

I did not flinch.

I used to say — and still believe — that if you face consequences for
doing the right thing, even going to jail, that is not something to fear.
It’s an honor.

The power of unions exists to balance the greed of people who get to the
top and forget where they came from. Union power is not about taking
whatever we want. It’s about having the power to fix what’s wrong.

And throughout my life, I’ve tried to follow a simple rule: We have to do
the right thing.

Abdul grew up watching that. He was an amazing kid.

[ An ]An old photo of Prof. Mohamed and Abdul as a child

He’s always had a strong sense of justice and fairness, and that made him
really able to reach people — to feel what they feel and put himself in
their shoes.

That empathy shaped Abdul’s life, and it’s why he understands that the
struggle for healthcare in this country isn’t going away on its own.

Healthcare was at the center of our faculty strike. It almost always is.

This issue is one of the great unfinished fights of our time, and it’ll
only be settled when people like Abdul get into the Senate and convince
others that access to healthcare is good for the country.

Being president of my union taught me that when power is abused, you don’t
look away — you stand up and do the right thing. Abdul is carrying that
lesson forward by running a Senate campaign with the UAW’s endorsement
that isn’t afraid to fight for working people.

[ https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/507?c0=em-ms-aes-20260621-2-ak.w_zye5&amount=10&refcode=em20260621-2397&t=1004&akid=2412%2E251025%2EWZODM5 ]If you’re able to, I hope you’ll consider supporting him by donating
today:

[ https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/507?c0=em-ms-aes-20260621-2-ak.w_zye5&amount=10&refcode=em20260621-2397&t=1023&akid=2412%2E251025%2EWZODM5 ]Donate $10 ››

I’m so proud of my son, and I believe he’s the kind of leader this country
needs right now (iA).

Thank you for taking the time to read this.

With gratitude,

Dr. Mohamed El-Sayed

body:
June 21, 2026 | Read Online ( https://de717de0.click.kit-mail3.com/xmu9er6g3ph6hp58826h5h2ene26nbnh28k4m/g3hnh5hm8np2x2srh9/aHR0cHM6Ly9ja2FyY2hpdmUuY29tL2IvOGt1cWhvaDJtZWVkdmYzbjY2bW5xZmtvdm9rMmRhM2hreDlnNQ== )

A quick note before we dive in: we're once again hearing that our emails are landing in spam folders — or not arriving at all. If you'd like to stay on our engaged reader list, just click here ( https://de717de0.click.kit-mail3.com/xmu9er6g3ph6hp58826h5h2ene26nbnh28k4m/9qhzhnhdvx98n7a9h3/aHR0cHM6Ly90cnVldGhldm90ZS5vcmc= ) and you'll be all set. Nothing else is needed on your end.

And if you're new to the newsletter, or it's been a while since one of ours last reached you — hello and welcome back! We're glad you're here.

Our mission hasn't changed. The good fight for transparency, accountability, and trust in our elections matters now more than ever, and we're grateful you're standing with us in it.

**********************
The TTV Weekly Wrap Up
**********************

If there was a theme this week, it was accountability.

From FBI inquiries in Ohio and voter fraud investigations in California, to election lawsuits, legislative maneuvering, and battles over voter rolls, the pressure for transparency isn't slowing down. Citizens are asking questions, lawmakers are changing laws, and courts are weighing in. Across the country, election officials are finding themselves under increasing scrutiny.

Public confidence is built when the public can see, verify, and understand what's happening—not when they're simply told to trust the process.

Here's what you may have missed this week.

-->Stand With True the Vote ( https://de717de0.click.kit-mail3.com/xmu9er6g3ph6hp58826h5h2ene26nbnh28k4m/3ohphkh35rz8x6srhn/dHJ1ZXRoZXZvdGUub3JnL2RvbmF0ZQ== )
Stand With True the Vote ( truethevote.org/donate )We can't do this without you — and we wouldn't want to.

Thank you for your support!

In Case You Missed It...
------------------------

( https://de717de0.click.kit-mail3.com/xmu9er6g3ph6hp58826h5h2ene26nbnh28k4m/n2hohvhv9gr428c6hg/aHR0cHM6Ly90cnV0aHNvY2lhbC5jb20vQHRydWV0aGV2b3RlLzExNjc2MDkzNzk0ODM5NTg2Nw== )

-------------------------
California: Bubbling Over
-------------------------

Prosecutors indicate ( https://de717de0.click.kit-mail3.com/xmu9er6g3ph6hp58826h5h2ene26nbnh28k4m/48hvhehmd9g3wpuxh7/aHR0cHM6Ly9qdXN0dGhlbmV3cy5jb20vZ292ZXJubWVudC9jb3VydHMtbGF3L3VzLWF0dG9ybmV5LWNhbGlmb3JuaWEtc3VzcGVjdHMtdm90ZXItZnJhdWQtaW52ZXN0aWdhdGlvbi13aWxsLXJlc3VsdC1jaGFyZ2Vz ) criminal charges may be forthcoming, a 2023 investigation ( https://de717de0.click.kit-mail3.com/xmu9er6g3ph6hp58826h5h2ene26nbnh28k4m/wnh2hghq24gdm4t7hx/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVzdGljZS5nb3YvdXNhby1lZGNhL3ByL2NhbGlmb3JuaWEtcG9saXRpY2FsLWNvbnN1bHRhbnQtYW5kLWZvcm1lci1wdWJsaWMtb2ZmaWNpYWwtY2hhcmdlZC1jb25zcGlyYWN5LWNvbW1pdA== ) into Newsom's Chief of Staff has made new headlines, and AG Bill Essayli calls ( https://de717de0.click.kit-mail3.com/xmu9er6g3ph6hp58826h5h2ene26nbnh28k4m/reh8hohml7xpkvf2h6/aHR0cHM6Ly94LmNvbS9VU0F0dHlFc3NheWxpL3N0YXR1cy8yMDY2MTkyMzE5MTU4ODUzNzEyP3M9MjA= ) for an audit of the voter rolls.

-->Read Our Take ( https://de717de0.click.kit-mail3.com/xmu9er6g3ph6hp58826h5h2ene26nbnh28k4m/n2hohvhv9gr428c6hg/aHR0cHM6Ly90cnV0aHNvY2lhbC5jb20vQHRydWV0aGV2b3RlLzExNjc2MDkzNzk0ODM5NTg2Nw== )
Read Our Take ( https://truthsocial.com/@truethevote/116760937948395867 )

( https://de717de0.click.kit-mail3.com/xmu9er6g3ph6hp58826h5h2ene26nbnh28k4m/08hwh9h26xz4nkalh5/aHR0cHM6Ly9jb3VydGhvdXNlbmV3cy5jb20vY2FsaWZvcm5pYS1zdWVzLXNoYXN0YS1jb3VudHktb3Zlci1uZXdseS1wYXNzZWQtdm90ZXItaWQtYmFsbG90LW1lYXN1cmUv )

------------------------------------
Shasta County, CA: Voter ID Showdown
------------------------------------

California is suing Shasta County over a newly-approved voter ID measure, arguing local governments lack authority to impose election requirements beyond state law. The case could become a major test of how much control counties have over their own election processes.

-->Read More ( https://de717de0.click.kit-mail3.com/xmu9er6g3ph6hp58826h5h2ene26nbnh28k4m/08hwh9h26xz4nkalh5/aHR0cHM6Ly9jb3VydGhvdXNlbmV3cy5jb20vY2FsaWZvcm5pYS1zdWVzLXNoYXN0YS1jb3VudHktb3Zlci1uZXdseS1wYXNzZWQtdm90ZXItaWQtYmFsbG90LW1lYXN1cmUv )
Read More ( https://courthousenews.com/california-sues-shasta-county-over-newly-passed-voter-id-ballot-measure/ )

( https://de717de0.click.kit-mail3.com/xmu9er6g3ph6hp58826h5h2ene26nbnh28k4m/8ghqhoho6398w5fkh9/aHR0cHM6Ly9rdGFyLmNvbS9hcml6b25hLXBvbGl0aWNzLW5ld3MvanVzdGluLWhlYXAtZWxlY3Rpb24tZmlnaHQvNTg4MDE2My8= )

--------------------------------------
Maricopa County, AZ: Election Turf War
--------------------------------------

A dispute between Arizona Secretary of State Adrian Fontes and Maricopa County Recorder Justin Heap is escalating into a broader debate over election authority, administration, and who ultimately controls key election functions in the state's largest county.

-->Read More ( https://de717de0.click.kit-mail3.com/xmu9er6g3ph6hp58826h5h2ene26nbnh28k4m/8ghqhoho6398w5fkh9/aHR0cHM6Ly9rdGFyLmNvbS9hcml6b25hLXBvbGl0aWNzLW5ld3MvanVzdGluLWhlYXAtZWxlY3Rpb24tZmlnaHQvNTg4MDE2My8= )
Read More ( https://ktar.com/arizona-politics-news/justin-heap-election-fight/5880163/ )

( https://de717de0.click.kit-mail3.com/xmu9er6g3ph6hp58826h5h2ene26nbnh28k4m/vqh3hrho94g6mntghl/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cud2FiZS5vcmcvd2l0aC1qdWx5LTEtZGVhZGxpbmUtbG9vbWluZy1sYXdtYWtlcnMtcHV6emxlLW92ZXItd2hhdC10by1kby1hYm91dC1nZW9yZ2lhcy1lbGVjdGlvbi1zeXN0ZW0v )

--------------------------------
Georgia: QR Codes Out. Now What?
--------------------------------

With Georgia's QR code ban taking effect July 1, state officials are still debating how elections should be conducted moving forward. The technology exists. The deadline is real. The question is whether leadership will act before voters are caught in the middle.

-->Read More ( https://de717de0.click.kit-mail3.com/xmu9er6g3ph6hp58826h5h2ene26nbnh28k4m/vqh3hrho94g6mntghl/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cud2FiZS5vcmcvd2l0aC1qdWx5LTEtZGVhZGxpbmUtbG9vbWluZy1sYXdtYWtlcnMtcHV6emxlLW92ZXItd2hhdC10by1kby1hYm91dC1nZW9yZ2lhcy1lbGVjdGlvbi1zeXN0ZW0v )
Read More ( https://www.wabe.org/with-july-1-deadline-looming-lawmakers-puzzle-over-what-to-do-about-georgias-election-system/ )

( https://de717de0.click.kit-mail3.com/xmu9er6g3ph6hp58826h5h2ene26nbnh28k4m/l2hehmhlm4rpq3c6h0/aHR0cHM6Ly9sZWdpdHJhY2sub3Jn )

---------------------------------------
Closing Loopholes, Tightening Elections
---------------------------------------

HR 9264 ( https://de717de0.click.kit-mail3.com/xmu9er6g3ph6hp58826h5h2ene26nbnh28k4m/m2h7h5h369ex23smhq/aHR0cHM6Ly9sZWdpdHJhY2sub3JnL2JpbGxzLzE3Njg4Lw== ) would close federal loopholes allowing exceptions to noncitizen voting.

NC HB 958 ( https://de717de0.click.kit-mail3.com/xmu9er6g3ph6hp58826h5h2ene26nbnh28k4m/dpheh0he9k5xd8tmh4/aHR0cHM6Ly9sZWdpdHJhY2sub3JnL2JpbGxzLzE0MDE5Lw== ) would ban Ranked Choice Voting, tighten absentee voting procedures, strengthen signature verification, and prohibit foreign national contributions.

-->Visit LegiTrack ( https://de717de0.click.kit-mail3.com/xmu9er6g3ph6hp58826h5h2ene26nbnh28k4m/l2hehmhlm4rpq3c6h0/aHR0cHM6Ly9sZWdpdHJhY2sub3Jn )
Visit LegiTrack ( https://legitrack.org )

( https://de717de0.click.kit-mail3.com/xmu9er6g3ph6hp58826h5h2ene26nbnh28k4m/e0hph7h73e4zm4b8h2/aHR0cHM6Ly94LmNvbS9BQUdEaGlsbG9uL3N0YXR1cy8yMDY2ODcyMjIxNjk2NTEyMjY3P3M9MjA= )

--------------------------
Georgia: Judge Steps Aside
--------------------------

After it came to light that an Atlanta-based Federal District Court judge for the Northern District of Georgia, Eleanor Ross, was subject to a private reprimand for having sex with a police officer in chambers in earshot of law clerks, the DOJ moved to recuse her from a pending lawsuit over Georgia’s voter rolls. The DOJ’s motion was granted - and Judge Ross has recused herself from the case.

-->Read the Order ( https://de717de0.click.kit-mail3.com/xmu9er6g3ph6hp58826h5h2ene26nbnh28k4m/e0hph7h73e4zm4b8h2/aHR0cHM6Ly94LmNvbS9BQUdEaGlsbG9uL3N0YXR1cy8yMDY2ODcyMjIxNjk2NTEyMjY3P3M9MjA= )
Read the Order ( https://x.com/AAGDhillon/status/2066872221696512267?s=20 )

( https://de717de0.click.kit-mail3.com/xmu9er6g3ph6hp58826h5h2ene26nbnh28k4m/7qh7h8h928zed3szh6/aHR0cHM6Ly9zaWduYWxvaGlvLm9yZy9mYmktcXVlc3Rpb25lZC1jdXlhaG9nYS1lbGVjdGlvbnMtb2ZmaWNpYWxzLWFib3V0LXZvdGVyLXJlZ2lzdHJhdGlvbi8= )

--------------------------
Ohio: The FBI Came Calling
--------------------------

$10.6 million. That’s what OOC’s political arm paid one consulting firm, owned by an OOC founder, for canvassing that produced registrations for dead voters across four Ohio counties. The FBI was already asking questions in early 2025. Read it for yourself.

-->Read More ( https://de717de0.click.kit-mail3.com/xmu9er6g3ph6hp58826h5h2ene26nbnh28k4m/7qh7h8h928zed3szh6/aHR0cHM6Ly9zaWduYWxvaGlvLm9yZy9mYmktcXVlc3Rpb25lZC1jdXlhaG9nYS1lbGVjdGlvbnMtb2ZmaWNpYWxzLWFib3V0LXZvdGVyLXJlZ2lzdHJhdGlvbi8= )

https://legitrack.org/bills/14725/ ( https://de717de0.click.kit-mail3.com/xmu9er6g3ph6hp58826h5h2ene26nbnh28k4m/p8heh9h4wdxer6sqh3/aHR0cHM6Ly9sZWdpdHJhY2sub3JnL2JpbGxzLzE0NzI1Lw== )

Lead From Where You Stand
-------------------------

Trust is earned.

Sometimes FBI investigations, voter ID lawsuits, election law battles, judicial recusals, and growing scrutiny of election administration across the country are signs that citizens are paying attention.

The moment we stop asking questions is the moment accountability disappears.

Keep watching. Keep learning. Keep showing up.

Lead from where you stand.

What You Can Do
---------------

* A call to action: if you or someone you know can obtain the Kentucky voter rolls, please reach out to us ( https://de717de0.click.kit-mail3.com/xmu9er6g3ph6hp58826h5h2ene26nbnh28k4m/x0hph6hevz3mk0u5hl/aHR0cHM6Ly90cnVldGhldm90ZS5vcmcvY29udGFjdA== ).

Confirm your record and track your ballot - before it becomes a problem.
* Help us test the new version of Scan. Check. Protect. If you live in Hawaii, North Dakota, Mississippi, or Missouri, we need you! Contact us ( https://de717de0.click.kit-mail3.com/xmu9er6g3ph6hp58826h5h2ene26nbnh28k4m/x0hph6hevz3mk0u5hl/aHR0cHM6Ly90cnVldGhldm90ZS5vcmcvY29udGFjdA== ) and we'll walk you through the next steps. (P.S. — if you've already reached out, thank you!!)
* See something, say something — cliché, but true. Are you receiving ballots or voter-related mail you didn't request? Take pictures and send us the details through our report line ( https://de717de0.click.kit-mail3.com/xmu9er6g3ph6hp58826h5h2ene26nbnh28k4m/z2hghnhe27wz5nbph0/aHR0cHM6Ly90cnVldGhldm90ZS5vcmcvaGVscGxpbmU= ).
* Stay informed on election legislation ( https://de717de0.click.kit-mail3.com/xmu9er6g3ph6hp58826h5h2ene26nbnh28k4m/l2hehmhlm4rpq3c6h0/aHR0cHM6Ly9sZWdpdHJhY2sub3Jn ). What is your state doing? Track it all in LegiTrack before it becomes law.
* Get involved locally ( https://de717de0.click.kit-mail3.com/xmu9er6g3ph6hp58826h5h2ene26nbnh28k4m/kkhmh6hn0empz0ulh7/aHR0cHM6Ly9jb21tdW5pdHkudHR2bm93Lm9yZw== ). Join grassroots efforts in your state, attend local meetings, support transparency work, and help educate others on the issues shaping their communities.
* Vote! The evidence is clear: when you make the effort, you see the results. Shut out the voices that tell you your vote doesn't matter — it matters!!
* Pray for wisdom, courage, and discernment. No matter where you stand politically, this is a defining moment for the country and for the people entrusted with stewarding it.
* Support our work ( https://de717de0.click.kit-mail3.com/xmu9er6g3ph6hp58826h5h2ene26nbnh28k4m/58hvh7hgd07w3rf6h4/aHR0cHM6Ly90cnVldGhldm90ZS5vcmcvZG9uYXRl ) if you're able. Every volunteer hour, conversation, share, and donation helps strengthen the movement for transparency, accountability, and citizen engagement.

Tools for Your Toolkit
----------------------

You weren't meant to do this alone. Find your community, your tools, your purpose.

-->Become a Member ( https://de717de0.click.kit-mail3.com/xmu9er6g3ph6hp58826h5h2ene26nbnh28k4m/25h2hoh3pgdxlmb3h4/aHR0cHM6Ly9jb21tdW5pdHkudHR2bm93Lm9yZy9jaGVja291dC9iZWNvbWUtYS1tZW1iZXI= )
Become a Member ( https://community.ttvnow.org/checkout/become-a-member )

Stay ahead of the legislation shaping your elections and know when it's time to act.

Join LegiTrack ( https://legitrack.org/#bill-tracker )

Until Next Week
---------------

Remember: you don't need a title, a law degree, or permission to get involved. You need awareness, courage, and the conviction to stay engaged when others walk away.

Real change starts with citizens who refuse to look away.

True the Vote will keep doing our part. With faith as our foundation and patriots like you standing in the gap, we'll keep pressing forward—for transparency, accountability, liberty, and the America we're determined to leave stronger than we found it.

Ever onward.

-->Stand With True the Vote ( https://de717de0.click.kit-mail3.com/xmu9er6g3ph6hp58826h5h2ene26nbnh28k4m/3ohphkh35rz8x6srhn/dHJ1ZXRoZXZvdGUub3JnL2RvbmF0ZQ== )
Stand With True the Vote ( truethevote.org/donate )We can't do this without you — and we wouldn't want to.

Thank you for your support!

Grounded in Truth
-----------------

A weekly word from the TTV team. Want one every day? Join us in TTV Now. ( https://de717de0.click.kit-mail3.com/xmu9er6g3ph6hp58826h5h2ene26nbnh28k4m/25h2hoh3pgdxlmb3h4/aHR0cHM6Ly9jb21tdW5pdHkudHR2bm93Lm9yZy9jaGVja291dC9iZWNvbWUtYS1tZW1iZXI= )

But we know that no chain is stronger than Your calling and no mountain is greater than Your power. Remind us that when You have called us, chains do not cancel our purpose. There is no obstacle or situation that is stronger than You. And You are the God Who makes the impossible possible.

Father, for those who feel stuck in their circumstances or feel bound in chains, we ask that You strengthen their hearts and renew their courage. Expose the darkness, reveal the truth, and let every chain and every shadow retreat as Your light advances.

In Jesus' Name, Amen.

# [Happy Father’s Day!](https://bethfarnhamforcongress.com/2026/06/21/happy-fathers-day/?jetpack_skip_subscription_popup)
---
By **Elizabeth Farnham** on June 21, 2026
---
| **District Round-up 06.21.26**
---
Dear Neighbor, Thank you for reading my District Round-up. As your candidate for Pennsylvania’s 13th Congressional District, it is my honor and pleasure to deliver to you where I’ve been and what issues I’ve tackled in the past week. Criss-crossing the counties of Adams, Franklin, Fulton, Bedford, Cambria, Blair, Huntingdon, Mifflin, Juniata, Perry, Cumberland, and Somerset gives me great opportunities to meet with voters, hear what is on your hearts and minds, and the chance to voice my fight for Everyday Americans. If you would like to contribute to my campaign, please donate here:**[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/beth-farnham-for-congress-1](http://bethfarnhamforcongress.com?action=user_content_redirect&uuid=109c73180655165826afc0835549f4b11b2a57e5a31bf53c07064f76744b4f8e&blog_id=213069660&post_id=7906&user_id=248418217&subs_id=487468588&signature=aaaa24116f984c98892d2465a6038273&email_name=new-post&user_email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&encoded_url=aHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYWN0Ymx1ZS5jb20vZG9uYXRlL2JldGgtZmFybmhhbS1mb3ItY29uZ3Jlc3MtMQ=&email_id=1ff394da4de2b3852c75cfa602653464)**
---
| **Happy Juneteenth Weekend!**
---
| |
---
Many thanks to Chambersburg Borough Council Member Lu Butler and Friends for back-to-back inspiring Juneteenth events on Friday, June 19th and Saturday, June 20th at the Spring Street Amphitheater.
---
Thank you also to the Beth Farnham for Congress volunteers who pitched in to make this event a success- Sue, Claire, Deb, Jack, Brian, Angie, Chris, Bretni, and Don.
---
Chambersburg community members talked, broke luscious cinnamon rolls together, sang, and joined hands in several beautiful moments of unity and spirit. I especially appreciate the opportunity to address attendees on the meaning of Juneteenth.
---
I also spoke to voters and listened to what is on their hearts and minds.
---
So many are rightly concerned about violations of human rights as the current administration dehumanizes anyone who is not a wealthy white male.
---
Just when we’re celebrating freedom from slavery on a national holiday, we’re simultaneously experiencing neighbors, family, and coworkers being snatched away on trumped up charges and denied humane treatment.
---
But when you vote me into Congress, I’ll work with other caring legislators to right these wrongs.
---
Bet.
---
Please vote for me, Beth Farnham, on November 3rd.
---
Together, we #ChooseDemocracy and Humanity!
---
Photo credits: Jack Stansbury, DCI, Sue Oberman, and Claire Meissner.
---
| | |
---|---|---
| |
---|---|---
---
| **“The Doctor” is NOT in!**
---
| |
---
“I’m a doctor...As a doctor...”
---
Listen to any speech from our own US Representative, multimillionaire John Joyce, or look at any of his yard signs and he’s sure to remind you of his cherished title.
---
But when an incompetent administration spouts lies about evidenced-based medicine, “The Doctor” (as some constituents refer to him) is nowhere to be found.
---
While Secretary of Defense, Pete Hegseth, falsely claims that the flu vaccine will “weaken war fighting capabilities,” 160 troops have fallen ill with the flu at an Air Force base in Texas.
---
Guess which troops are now the LEAST ready to fight in any combat??
---
Meanwhile, the total number of measles cases in Pennsylvania for this year alone has reached 67 and the United States is at risk of losing its “eliminated” status for measles.
---
But where is the person who wants everyone to know that he’s a (retired) dermatologist?
---
Well, he’s not speaking out about the flu vaccine, or the measles vaccine, nor does he advocate botanical science in the case of Trump’s failed attempts to combat the algae in the national reflecting pool.
---
Look, a medical degree is an admirable thing, but if the person who earned it is not fighting for solutions to disease transmission beyond herpes, if he is quietly condoning disinformation, then he shouldn’t represent us, especially not children and military members.
---
Worse, he even voted for thousands of his constituents to lose their healthcare last July.
---
I, Beth Farnham, however will advocate good health, including healthcare for all, rooted in evidence based-science.
---
I may not have a medical degree, but I have the good sense to fight for actual solutions to what ails us.
---
Please vote for me this November 3rd.
---
Together, we[ #ChooseDemocracy](http://bethfarnhamforcongress.com?action=user_content_redirect&uuid=e28add0b6aaea4ca08c4ea4990994726efcf346df42a01d208a77a5985a7d733&blog_id=213069660&post_id=7906&user_id=248418217&subs_id=487468588&signature=d816fa8a0f6ad0576ff22458e3b2ef1d&email_name=new-post&user_email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&encoded_&email_id=1ff394da4de2b3852c75cfa602653464) and good health!
---
| | **My Neighbor’s Bounty Celebrates 5 Years!**
---
| |
---
Many thanks to the Tuscarora Chamber of Commerce for hosting a mixer at My Neighbor’s Bounty in Mercersburg!
---
It was a delightful evening to celebrate their 5 year anniversary with nibbles and good conversation.
---
I learned:
---
– 75% of the people they serve are aged 60 and over.
---
– that the SNAP funding gap this past Fall had a big impact on the people they serve, though the Central Food Bank helped tremendously.
---
– that produce and fresh meat are harder to come by, but candy is abundant.
---
– that a local business once donated dozens of eggs, but now donates nothing.
---
– that the Food Lion in Mercersburg is a big source of the food in the freezer section.
---
– that the Mercersburg Academy donates generously to the organization.
---
– that the number of people they serve has increased over time.
---
– that sometimes the food pantry is one of the first places people in crisis turn to and need services beyond what the food pantry offers.
---
Since our own Representative, multimillionaire John Joyce, won’t actually walk into a place like this and regret having voted for the One Big Beautiful Bill Act which removes food assistance from six thousand of his own constituents, please elect me, Beth Farnham, instead.
---
I care about our neighbors in need and never want them to starve. I believe in strengthening our social safety nets like SNAP, so hungry people don’t have to rely so heavily on charity. And Social Security should effectively cover the nutritional needs for Everyday Americans in their retirement. If you would like to give to this charity, follow the link in the comments.
---
Together, we #ChooseDemocracy and dignity!
---
| |
---
| **Congratulations to Leah Ritchey!**
---
Congratulations to Leah Ritchey who took home top honors from the 2026 Congressional Art Competition!
---

# [#]
Peter, —

Join me in celebrating all the fathers, step-fathers, grandfathers, brothers, uncles, and friends – past and present. They have encouraged us, shown us unconditional love, and inspired us to be the best person we can.

Being a father is a great honor. We all know how important dads are in shaping our kids, and equally as important, how our kids also teach us to learn, grow, and be better every day. Being a father is one of the most rewarding jobs I’ve ever had the honor of holding.

Happy Father’s Day to you and yours, Peter. Today and every day, let’s celebrate all the fathers and father-figures out there!

Mike Thompson

Last weekend, my family headed north to watch my 15-year-old son Kai deliver a speech to the Rotary Club in Orford, Quebec. As someone who has been a professional speaker for more than 15 years, I was genuinely impressed by both his message and delivery. I could not have been more proud.
I hope you'll indulge me on this Father's Day and take 6 minutes to watch (or at least listen to) his speech. Yes, I'm a proud father who wants to brag about his son. But I'm also a concerned citizen and want his powerful message of hope and optimism to be shared and spread as widely as possible. He offers a path towards a more compassionate and peaceful politics.

Governor Hobbs has spent the last term fighting for affordable child care, taking on cross-border fentanyl trafficking, and protecting Arizona's water — all while Republicans tried to ram through their agenda in the legislature. Something broke this week that connects every alarm we have raised about this Supreme Court into a single, damning picture.
Justice Samuel Alito's son has been secretly working as an attorney inside the Treasury Department since the early months of Trump's second term, briefed on the most sensitive legal matters across the entire department, offering counsel at the highest level on Treasury policy and law.
Alito's son was working inside the Treasury Department while a lawsuit challenging Trump's emergency powers landed before the court with the Treasury named as a defendant. He maintained no public profile, avoided giving his last name, and the Treasury never disclosed his employment in court filings. His father did not recuse himself.
The Treasury Department is now administering Trump's $1.8 billion "Anti-Weaponization Fund," taxpayer money with no congressional approval and no independent oversight, currently paying out to the January 6th insurrectionists Trump pardoned. Alito's son sits in the office providing legal oversight for that fund. When challenges reach the Supreme Court, they land in front of a bench that includes his father.

This is the court Leonard Leo built with $1.6 billion in dark money. The court that granted Trump criminal immunity. The court that gutted the Voting Rights Act. The court that opened the floodgates for the unlimited dark money that paid for all of it.

This email is a bit on the longer side, so](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/133753786/628953184/628610392?amounts=5,10,15,25,50,100,250&amount=5&refcode=email_062126_bio-RS&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3MTc5Mjc0Mi1hZDZkLWYxMTEtOGZjYi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2ZDYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=v9oPTDy4Um-A63PR05tIDIHwhPsXhS0nzB1W8jQVngA=) [_if you don’t have the time to read more, I’m going to ask if you could pitch in $5 to my reelection campaign._](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/133753787/628953185/628610392?amounts=5,10,15,25,50,100,250&amount=5&refcode=email_062126_bio-RS&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3MTc5Mjc0Mi1hZDZkLWYxMTEtOGZjYi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2ZDYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=v9oPTDy4Um-A63PR05tIDIHwhPsXhS0nzB1W8jQVngA=) [But if you have a minute or two to spare, please keep going!](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/133753788/628953186/628610392?amounts=5,10,15,25,50,100,250&amount=5&refcode=email_062126_bio-RS&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3MTc5Mjc0Mi1hZDZkLWYxMTEtOGZjYi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2ZDYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=v9oPTDy4Um-A63PR05tIDIHwhPsXhS0nzB1W8jQVngA=)** When I moved to Oregon in 1987, right off an Amtrak train from the East Coast to rainy Eugene, I was excited about a new place to explore and find new friends. As I settled in, I found much more — a place where I could truly be myself. I fell in love with the beauty of the state and the openness of the people — and found a community I could call home. After going back to school and graduating from the University of Oregon, working in politics was not on my radar. My journey eventually led me to nonprofit advocacy work at Oregon Food Bank and then Children First for Oregon — fighting hunger, supporting financial stability for more people, and strengthening state policies around childcare for working families and healthcare for kids. It was through that work — listening to Oregonians, working on issues our communities are facing, and helping create real solutions — that I realized I could make an even bigger difference through public service. That led me to nearly 15 years of service in the Oregon legislature. [**As Governor, my focus remains the same: listening to Oregonians, tackling our biggest challenges, and building a stronger, brighter future for all of us.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/133753789/628953187/628610392?amounts=5,10,15,25,50,100,250&amount=5&refcode=email_062126_bio-RS&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3MTc5Mjc0Mi1hZDZkLWYxMTEtOGZjYi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2ZDYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=v9oPTDy4Um-A63PR05tIDIHwhPsXhS0nzB1W8jQVngA=) It’s my honor to not just work for you, _but with you_. With your support and partnership, I’ve worked to lower costs, address our housing crisis, strengthen schools, expand mental health care, and defend Oregon from Trump’s dangerous agenda. But the work is far from over, especially with all the challenges that President Trump and a Republican-led Congress have presented us. [_**I’m running for reelection because Oregon’s values are on the line — and I’m not stopping my fight to build a better future for our state. I’ve been tackling Oregon’s biggest challenges head-on, and I need your help to keep up the work. Yep, Peter — that’s what is at stake this November.
This week, we rolled out an aggressive campaign to win the midterm elections in key priority states where the outcomes will be pivotal to the future of our democracy — the places where we can potentially overturn or stop a future Republican gerrymander, as well as where we can enact a countermeasure to help level the playing field.
Let me pull back the curtain and tell you exactly where the NDRC will — at a minimum — focus its resources:
* **Arizona:** Governor, State House, State Senate
* **Colorado:** Governor, Redistricting Ballot Initiative
* **Florida:** Governor
* **Georgia:** Governor, State House
* **Michigan:** State Supreme Court
* **Minnesota:** Governor, State House, State Senate
* **Missouri:** Redistricting Referendum
* **New Hampshire:** Governor, State House, State Senate
* **North Carolina:** State Supreme Court
* **Ohio:** Governor, Secretary of State, Auditor, State Supreme Court
* **Pennsylvania:** Governor, State House, State Senate
* **Texas:** Governor, State House
* **Washington:** State House, State Senate
* **Wisconsin:** Governor, State Assembly, State Senate

**Let’s be honest: That’s a long list. It’s a lot of elections that will require serious investments of time and resources. **
Some might look at this and ask us to narrow it down some more. Trust me, we’d love to. But we just can’t take that risk. Falling short in these races could lead to devastating consequences for democracy — not just in these 14 states but for the prospect of returning to an era when Republicans can’t just rip up maps every time they’re losing.
I know we ask a lot of you. Thank you for understanding why our grassroots movement is needed so urgently right now. Tequila is cheaper than therapy, and this week [Cliff Schecter](https://open.substack.com/users/31941177-cliff-schecter?utm_source=mentions) needed both. With Joe Walsh out, [Julie Roginsky](https://open.substack.com/users/36550640-julie-roginsky?utm_source=mentions) pulled up a chair--Cliff's chair is held together with duct tape, jokes, and a whole lot of ranting--to take apart Donald Trump's so-called Iran "deal." Though, Cliff refused to dignify what Trump just did with the word, "deal," which implies both sides gave something up.
Trump is on his knees handing over to Iran a reported **$300 billion,** leaving their ballistic missiles intact, walking away from the International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA) inspections the JCPOA that President Obama negotiated delivered--and WORKED--and you don't have the art of the deal. You have a complete and total capitulation.
Cliff provided some simple math: that same $300 billion could have _bought universal child care, paid family leave, and free public college for every American for a year_ --and instead it went to the world's largest state sponsor of terror while J.D. Vance threatens Israel and the hawks turn on each other, as they often do.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/67a4e1a3-df35-451e-b7d8-b15fc1f4325d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Then they took the show where most pundits won't. Julie and Cliff--both Jewish, both lifelong Democrats--confronted the anti-semitism curdling on parts of the left, from the Cornell student who openly said he wouldn't work for Jews to Zohran Mamdani's endorsement of a congressional candidate trafficking in Russian talking points and anti-Semitic blood libel.
Cliff was particularly disappointed--even angry--as he has supported Mamdani's economic plans and believes in grace for those who have, in the past, said some obnoxious things. He employed that when Mamdani ran--but this is happening _right now_. (even as Mamdani gave a great speech at the New York Knicks' parade, whereas [Trump just managed to stink up Madison Square Garden and cause the Knicks' to lose](https://substack.com/redirect/71d512b5-4801-46e5-9aa4-97de1902a332?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)).
They drew a line corporate media and some pundits on the Left keep blurring: criticizing Bibi Netanyahu, a war criminal, is fair game--in fact for any good human being, its required; yet, _**[assigning collective blame to every Jew and Israeli for what indicted criminal and unbelievable putz Netanyahu does, is not](https://substack.com/redirect/5c9e1821-ac91-4581-82cb-eb1fa9dc3bab?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**_. It is actually the very definition of anti-Semitism.
The edition of _Tequila Talk_ is raw, it's funny, and there was a fascinating discussion that ranged from the reason Cliff was drinking tequila from a paper cup, to a hotel in Antibes, France, so glitzy it wouldn't let Julie and her family inside it's gates!
And then Cliff shared the "weekly funny" at the end--how the bar owners of Boston are in shock as they have made emergency preparations to both brew more and import more beer _as Scottish World Cup fans have seemingly found a way to drink the town of Boston dry_. 😆😆
Speaking of that, pour something out for yourself and watch this great episode of _Tequila Talk_!

Meet Coach Tuberville:

**Coach Tuberville was born in Camden, Arkansas, the third of three children of Olive and Charles Tuberville. College Football’s 2004 Coach of the Year and two-time SEC Coach of the Year, Tommy Tuberville is most often recognized for his success on the field. But it is the legacy of his father, a highly decorated WWII veteran and Purple Heart recipient, that motivates Coach Tuberville to give back to the brave men and women of the United States Armed Forces.

In 1989 Coach Tuberville met his future wife, Suzanne Fette, at the Sugar Bowl in New Orleans. They were married in 1991 and have two boys, Tucker and Troy, who continue to make their dad proud.

In his career as a College Football Coach, Tommy started a long and successful career at the University of Miami, starting as a graduate assistant and rising to the Hurricanes' defensive coordinator. He led the Canes to three AP national championships and coached future Hall of Famers Ray Lewis and Warren Sapp, as well as Dwayne "The Rock" Johnson.

In 1998, Coach Tuberville was announced as the next head coach for the Auburn Tigers. Tuberville’s time at Auburn was a success by any measure, as the Tigers captured eight consecutive bowl appearances, including five New Year’s Day bowl appearances, five SEC Western Division titles, one SEC Championship, and a 13-0 season in 2004, after which Coach Tuberville was once again named the AP’s SEC Coach of the Year. For his efforts during the perfect 2004 season, Tuberville would be named Paul “Bear” Bryant Coach of the Year, Associated Press Coach of the Year, Walter Camp Coach of the Year, Sporting News Coach of the Year, and AFCA Coach of the Year, among others.

_In 2020, Coach Tuberville became Senator Tuberville, winning his election to represent all Alabamians in the United States Senate with the full support of President Trump. Since then, he's supported President Trump's America-First policies while fighting off the Radical Left. In his first term as Senator, Tommy was one of eight Republicans to vote against certifying the 2020 election, has been a strong pro-life advocate, and called out Democrats for being pro-crime.

Now, Coach Tuberville is running for Governor so he can continue representing Alabamians and Americans in his homestate of Alabama. The Radical Left thinks they can flip Alabama blue and turn it into the California of the South. Can he count on your support? _

College Football’s 2004 Coach of the Year and two-time SEC Coach of the Year, Tommy Tuberville is most often recognized for his success on the field. But it is the legacy of his father, a highly decorated WWII veteran and Purple Heart recipient, that motivates Coach Tuberville to give back to the brave men and women of the United States Armed Forces. In 1989 Coach Tuberville met his future wife, Suzanne Fette, at the Sugar Bowl in New Orleans. They were married in 1991 and have two boys, Tucker and Troy, who continue to make their dad proud. In his career as a College Football Coach, Tommy started a long and successful career at the University of Miami, starting as a graduate assistant and rising to the Hurricanes' defensive coordinator. He led the Canes to three AP national championships and coached future Hall of Famers Ray Lewis and Warren Sapp, as well as Dwayne "The Rock" Johnson. In 1998, Coach Tuberville was announced as the next head coach for the Auburn Tigers. Tuberville’s time at Auburn was a success by any measure, as the Tigers captured eight consecutive bowl appearances, including five New Year’s Day bowl appearances, five SEC Western Division titles, one SEC Championship, and a 13-0 season in 2004, after which Coach Tuberville was once again named the AP’s SEC Coach of the Year. For his efforts during the perfect 2004 season, Tuberville would be named Paul “Bear” Bryant Coach of the Year, Associated Press Coach of the Year, Walter Camp Coach of the Year, Sporting News Coach of the Year, and AFCA Coach of the Year, among others. In 2020, Coach Tuberville became Senator Tuberville, winning his election to represent all Alabamians in the United States Senate with the full support of President Trump. Since then, he's supported President Trump's America-First policies while fighting off the Radical Left. In his first term as Senator, Tommy was one of eight Republicans to vote against certifying the 2020 election, has been a strong pro-life advocate, and called out Democrats for being pro-crime. Now, Coach Tuberville is running for Governor so he can continue representing Alabamians and Americans in his homestate of Alabama. The Radical Left thinks they can flip Alabama blue and turn it into the California of the South. Can he count on your support? | Sisters and Brothers -
The political future of our country rests upon one very simple principle: the need for working people to stand together and fight back against corporate greed, and create an economy that works for all of us, and not just billionaires and large corporations.
So when we have progressive candidates taking on the corporate establishment, the media establishment and the political establishment of this country, we have to do what we can to support them if we are going to have any chance at transforming this country and creating a government that works for all of us.
One of those candidates is Melat Kiros who is running for Congress in Colorado's 1st Congressional District.
She has shown she has the guts to stand up to corrupt special interests like AIPAC and Big Pharma. She understands that health care is a human right, that housing must be affordable, and that the billionaires and large corporations should not be allowed to buy our elections.
She was fired from her law firm for speaking out in defense of students protesting the genocide in Gaza and understands we should not be spending huge amounts of money to fund unconstitutional and illegal wars, and that we must end all military support to the extremist government in Israel.
Polls show this will be a very close race, but with outside spending ramping up against Melat she cannot win this alone. I intend to do what I can to help, but that is not enough. She needs all of us.
Not just me. Us.
So I am once again asking for your financial support:
[Please contribute $27 or what you can afford today to support Melat Kiros for Congress. How did Americans across the country, especially in the South, respond to the Supreme Court's decision to legally codify racial gerrymandering? They turned out in droves to march for their fundamental right to vote, folks.
For those of us who couldn't make it to Selma, Montgomery, or other places to march? We have to do everything we can to register a tidal wave of voters across the country.
Voter registration is a critical part of grassroots efforts to protect voting rights. The more people who vote, the more our government looks like we, the people. But to get to the point where every voice is heard, we need your help .
Every $3 chipped in can help us register a new voter. If you're with us in this fight, please pitch in $30 or whatever you can today to help register 10 new voters >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?refcode=062126_2&amount=30]
