This Supreme Court decision was a devastating blow to voting rights, but it only serves to strengthen our resolve. If anti-voting forces are going to stack the deck against the communities we serve, then we will work even harder to engage and rally these voters, lift their voices, and defend their right to vote.
Despite vote-suppressing courts and state legislatures making it harder to register to vote -- passing bills to stop organizations like ours and our partners on the ground from helping potential voters navigate the increasingly murky rules around voter registration -- we're still pulling out all the stops to bring voters into the system.
Voter participation has been increasing. Voting quickly becomes a habit -- a habit our democracy sorely needs to fulfill the promise of the American dream. Overwhelming key states with new voter registrations can help turn the tide against the voter suppression laws we've seen passed the last few years.
This voter registration work, at just about $3 per new voter, is how we can make the greatest impact. Fuel our efforts with $30 to give us the resources we need to register new voters ahead of the 2026 deadlines >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?refcode=062126_2&amount=30]

body:
This is a warning sign. You need to take this seriously

| | | | _**FROM THE DESK OF NEWT GINGRICH**_
---
Peter, I have been studying American elections for over fifty years. I helped engineer the 1994 Republican Revolution that gave us our first House majority in decades. I know what a warning sign looks like. And I am writing to you today because **what is happening in Texas right now is one of the most serious warning signs I have seen in a generation**.

_Let me give you the facts._

A new poll from Texas Public Opinion Research shows Democrat James Talarico leading Ken Paxton 47 to 44 percent in the Texas Senate race. Cook Political Report downgraded the race from Likely Republican to Lean Republican. And Talarico has raised over $40 million for this race, including $27 million in a single quarter, the largest first-quarter fundraising haul ever recorded by a Senate candidate in American history.

Now let me give you the history, because this is where it gets alarming.

**The party that has Majority control almost always loses ground in midterm elections.** It happened to Franklin Roosevelt in 1938. It happened to Lyndon Johnson in 1966. It happened to Bill Clinton in 1994. It happened to Barack Obama in 2010. And frankly, it happened to us in 2018. The American electorate has a long and consistent pattern of using the midterm election to push back against the party in power, and anyone who tells you 2026 will be different is not being honest with you.

The Democrats know this history better than anyone. They are running and fully supporting James Talarico in Texas because they have looked at the historical map, seen the midterm pattern, calculated the fundraising numbers, and decided that Texas is winnable. And right now, the polling and the money say they may be correct.

Here is what makes this moment even more critical. Talarico had no runoff. He spent three months doing nothing but raising money and organizing for the general election. He started the general election campaign with a three-month head start, a 3-point lead, and a $38 million fundraising advantage.

**_I have seen what happens when Republicans ignore these early warning signs. I have also seen what happens when we take them seriously and fight back._**

In 1994 we took them seriously. We organized. We raised the money. We delivered a message that resonated with the American people. And we won.

**Ken Paxton can win this race.** President Trump has already called James Talarico the worst Texas candidate he has ever seen and pledged to campaign across the state for Ken. But presidential rallies do not close a $38 million fundraising gap. Only grassroots conservatives like you can do that.

[**I am asking you today, as someone who has spent five decades fighting for this country and this party, to make an urgent contribution to Ken Paxton's campaign. Give $25, $50, $100, or whatever you can right now.**](http://links.stoppingsocialistdems.com/u/click?_t=4dcc2aab65fd4d0da6a107b0eef86d43&_m=975675a647b3460dab502a4123ca3eb8&_e=0OY1uN8Mt9GAQ8OhKJQrQWTptWsLBSDLgMfDEoqL6QRvDwhPMTktwK-r0h5gJM_YMunrFgExRHRVQHADC3omlWexM4NdF8wrZ_MYT6eYMbox1M_KJkgsQewdE3xXPwkxriBHkxEyHG-50YyYzXozo0SHnS27UyB5oHDk5By6pQxygayKugKTmbXNHwB4v5u8a_vsi36Dun_QCmZTCGaiBQW30hxHi5S27B_7xYs2oA3CBliHnM-l2qDZJCCGfJUV8fXbTWLmQM6X_O2RhfB31WyDhw6_7WXFJR4huTOKwKDagmyc3gOldUBDkwgZFA5PaGdZ0uAalSrjAwJXbXWcxE6GBDmiwSI788cJNEgrf6rTa9TMlOhON2gJ78FWlIjU6mYXAWwp_vgC1NJaEHvjVXilb5_VzTu6SnhAH1YJ0ymkZA_n0qu8dLjQS8PzsWb_GL1uCzXYfdlYn7U0eCME6hRT9KctDAoRP0w0jZUcPAdqQeDh0kSYvMrl54sGtaydHFYRo_wBwhPnl4RWM9v2Z8brGPJn7R7GKxRDqYwghIrY-O52Gu-ZuVnDsjv5WcPAMv3CA2GyT3O_J0rlmsjYXqTjejK7mFfT8iKSpKB3NOqTNEX08CSh2y0F6tyl7L1YhSiejiIA1bhgxdVQShoLQf7TlWY1IVP4Ap2R0XJHFdWaZndvIsomy7SLQgunSSSGStID5eb_ClNnQXyse9ag1yqg_pjbbK8s2ZArzTCVdzKpmz7jxso82V9o1a1DYCa61VZVBkyKP0-l56ckIXwjkPggT5pEx6kXDaTJ3jN_aOf8H_SPWMrKoRiApW_gjdwbZkyKLM73Dn-F4PvXZ9sA07Y_hruX8EeOuZzMdmcIGUQ58Oy2lkfaeMiqkvbziLg9VBhoc8lVvLg7pD8xOEn-8S9GYUlCUuAuFysZurvJV4Rx47_muix9MT-Q8ON480oqI5HRqwBtqWPWlEQTEFk66Jk2vi58ZHgNEu1-Ep-MqcM%3D)

Texas is not going to flip because the Democrats got lucky. It will only flip if we let them.

Do not let them flip Texas! Thanks,
Newt Gingrich
Former Speaker of the House

clean_body: This is a warning sign. You need to take this seriously | | | | FROM THE DESK OF NEWT GINGRICH Peter, I have been studying American elections for over fifty years. I helped engineer the 1994 Republican Revolution that gave us our first House majority in decades. I know what a warning sign looks like. And I am writing to you today because what is happening in Texas right now is one of the most serious warning signs I have seen in a generation. Let me give you the facts. A new poll from Texas Public Opinion Research shows Democrat James Talarico leading Ken Paxton 47 to 44 percent in the Texas Senate race. Cook Political Report downgraded the race from Likely Republican to Lean Republican. And Talarico has raised over $40 million for this race, including $27 million in a single quarter, the largest first-quarter fundraising haul ever recorded by a Senate candidate in American history. Now let me give you the history, because this is where it gets alarming. The party that has Majority control almost always loses ground in midterm elections. It happened to Franklin Roosevelt in 1938. It happened to Lyndon Johnson in 1966. It happened to Bill Clinton in 1994. It happened to Barack Obama in 2010. And frankly, it happened to us in 2018. The American electorate has a long and consistent pattern of using the midterm election to push back against the party in power, and anyone who tells you 2026 will be different is not being honest with you. The Democrats know this history better than anyone. They are running and fully supporting James Talarico in Texas because they have looked at the historical map, seen the midterm pattern, calculated the fundraising numbers, and decided that Texas is winnable. And right now, the polling and the money say they may be correct. Here is what makes this moment even more critical. Talarico had no runoff. He spent three months doing nothing but raising money and organizing for the general election. He started the general election campaign with a three-month head start, a 3-point lead, and a $38 million fundraising advantage. I have seen what happens when Republicans ignore these early warning signs. I have also seen what happens when we take them seriously and fight back. In 1994 we took them seriously. We organized. We raised the money. We delivered a message that resonated with the American people. And we won. Ken Paxton can win this race. President Trump has already called James Talarico the worst Texas candidate he has ever seen and pledged to campaign across the state for Ken. But presidential rallies do not close a $38 million fundraising gap. Only grassroots conservatives like you can do that. Texas is not going to flip because the Democrats got lucky. It will only flip if we let them. Do not let them flip Texas! Thanks, Newt Gingrich Former Speaker of the House P.S. | | | Paid for by Ken Paxton for Senate | | PO BOX 3476 MCKINNEY, TX 75070 | | |

# [](https://francescahong.com?refcode=em20260621-2942)
Peter,
This week's Sustainer Sunday Story comes from Ben Turk in Milwaukee, a longtime organizer who's been in Fran's corner since before she ever ran for governor.
**But before we dive in, quick reminder: The June 30 public filing deadline is looming, and we need to raise as much money as possible before then if we're going to make it to the next stage of the race.**
**[We need you now more than ever. Chip in what you can<3 ](https://act.francescahong.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_fh_20260621.5NlR-I&refcode=em20260621-2942&t=1&akid=2942%2E105371%2ErqFADP)**
OK, here's Ben!
[](https://act.francescahong.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_fh_20260621.5NlR-I&refcode=em20260621-2942&t=2&akid=2942%2E105371%2ErqFADP)
_When I heard Fran was running for governor, my hopes and expectations for the race, and Wisconsin's future immediately skyrocketed._
_I've been an abolitionist organizer since hearing about the Georgia Prison strike in 2010. The most important issue to me is eroding the power of the punishment bureaucracy. Conditions in our prisons are catastrophic, but invisible._
_Fran has not only got the best policy positions on prison issues — the conditions of confinement bill, banning juvenile life sentences, support for public defenders, community programs, and re-entry organizing — she also has the right core motivation._
_Fran's whole campaign is coming from compassion and service, and I believe she will extend those values to everyone in the state, even those who are hidden behind the high walls of Wisconsin's crowded, harmful prisons.__I've been impressed with her ability to bridge our more radical politics to a broader audience._
_Too often, Democrats try to woo independent voters by adopting harmful, conservative, pro-corporate policies, and it backfires. Fran will win independents and anti-elite conservatives with economic populism, with service, compassion, and people power._
_I've done a lot of organizing, and the enthusiasm of Fran Hong volunteers is unmatched in my experience._
_She is, by far, the most electable candidate in this primary._
**_\- Ben Turk, Milwaukee_**

| | | Thank you for opening this email. I'm writing you today because I wanted to share my story with you. If you have a minute, I'd really appreciate you giving this message a read. Thanks so much in advance! [](http://links.right-red.com/u/click?_t=7f2cc7f35be547959fee68a54bdac0d9&_m=821dbbfc52f148848c21232a90b6df05&_e=YimD9xctk2MMH4VAWTK_HhL1VXCDv0NNe_pyy50bmVqfBEyh2OCFodpsljNxGAWcr9AggNEEhYdDQj0WMjASs0lJbPuPIZFQ_Ud9qnwbVLCgO8RYlRPjjyN5H0UKo__5W7x8pM7SW8XYY_0vrBOY7aKrDn-orR5gJFbdnYeQuruGjtd9llj51QdmwvgHERezcvHMrXjzauRULtnLJ8eDS2ThMDNSBT7Vk2hxNWHLNQ5uXXv4ih3OObL1IEvsJjlFvjYeetbccsS3ZoHVZmse-cJiwzNm5GMt3NKjB2KuY3pT7WjjFSmGOghMqYtUrEV3L3gkklMYOKs7KaGjMDNrP3zcr1rU7C10RUtboQCLlXhSpmBxdiQl2cM7aZsXmAF_v1uk6E73180KAqiN0THM92zSf0-yx3WePnQD0l05xfofBvo7__zQ1A-D3pfrHGQC-oxOLlKTIa5OIOiRhsIKmbaO9of5FgAP_UjN6GAqloKLHKtFCcu8tH_Dd1L2-i-1w0D8So4mMj3oZk56hd2Bd0QXbFQctoibN06sI6GjqmP1lsH7pdr8-gvlwE34LLb2uk1a8t8reGuVuqsXv3-VcCxG_qJt-IqLRFBMgG0SC5pLXXTHYM_GQbH3s9WCr_V8Rkv5PGFC1ZpSpR-dy0a4z6uQY1fKufnFpUgILb4UCQ4cnH0fDzMW9K02GEWUSX9vhuFP30CJN9shZZj0oWlPNiVkig28Zx7cQIRzVN470AiJ-ox0htYMivvLEhGvBSqBDdkpCUlIrvwhDmnnFPzkkg%3D%3D) I know what it means to fight against the odds. Raised by a single mother on food stamps, I learned the value of hard work and resilience from a young age. I took those lessons with me when I joined the Navy at 18. I built on the grit and determination I was raised with during my 26 years of service. I became a Navy SEAL and defended our country from terrorists and extremists across the globe over 5 combat tours. But my commitment to service didn't end there. In 2020, I took on an entrenched Democrat incumbent and lost, but I refused to give up. I ran again in 2022 and won, becoming a freshman Congressman for Wisconsin's Third District. Against all odds, my Team and I defended this seat from furious and embarrassed Democrats in 2024. # **BREAKING: Iran-US Peace talks collapse as Trump threatens to "blow the s--t" out of Tehran**
Iranian negotiators **[abruptly walked out of peace talks in Switzerland Sunday](https://substack.com/redirect/3e59c486-ec85-4a37-96c3-8c166fccee37?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** after just 80 minutes, following what Tehran's state media called an "insulting message" from President Donald Trump. The talks, held at a Qatari-owned resort, were the first conducted under last week's memorandum of understanding and were led by Vice President Vance, who had hoped to "turn over a new leaf" with Iran.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/3e59c486-ec85-4a37-96c3-8c166fccee37?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

The collapse came after Iran's Revolutionary Guard Corps announced Saturday it was shutting down the strait, reportedly planning to charge tankers up to $2 million per crossing once formal negotiations conclude.
* **The breakdown marks a sharp reversal from a brief period of normalized shipping traffic,** during which 67 ships crossed the strait Saturday and 55 on Friday -- roughly matching pre-conflict volumes, according to Energy Secretary Chris Wright. The renewed tensions stem largely from continued Israeli strikes against Hezbollah in southern Lebanon, which had already strained the fragile US-Iran agreement.

* * *
# **Olympic canoeist arrested in Reflecting Pool vandalism case**
Three-time Olympian David Hearn, 67, **[was arrested by US Park Police](https://substack.com/redirect/45613785-56eb-4f11-86fb-8922962ee457?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** and charged with destruction of government property after allegedly touching peeling material at the newly renovated Lincoln Memorial Reflecting Pool. Hearn insists he was merely curious about the new coating's texture and denies pulling or tearing anything, though a viral video showed him being detained by National Guard troops and Park Police.

Joe Rogan disclosed on his podcast that he expressed concerns to President Donald Trump before UFC Freedom 250 about the possibility of a terrorist attack at the White House event, citing the president's history as a target. Trump reportedly responded casually, telling Rogan "we gotta go somehow."

| | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

name: Elizabeth Warren
subject: Re: competing against Sununu...
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Chris Pappas for Senate
body:
[](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/221?c0=em_ms_cp_20260621_3.9fW3ci&refcode=em20260621-3&t=1&akid=7325%2E582294%2EtLnSTs)
I know what it’s like to run against a Republican with high name ID and a national donor network behind him — I’ve done it before. And I won.
Now, Chris Pappas is facing the same kind of threat in New Hampshire. Donald Trump has personally endorsed former Senator John Sununu in this race — and the latest polling shows this race is a complete tie.
Look, in order for Democrats to take back the Senate majority and put an end to Trump’s unchecked power, winning in New Hampshire is absolutely critical.
**[That’s why I’m in this fight with everything I’ve got. And why I’m asking you to please pitch in $5 right now to help Chris Pappas stand up to big-money Republicans, compete against John Sununu, and keep this seat blue.](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/221?c0=em_ms_cp_20260621_3.9fW3ci&refcode=em20260621-3&t=2&akid=7325%2E582294%2EtLnSTs)**
**[Donate $5 to support Chris Pappas »](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260621_3.DkBTGg&refcode=em20260621-3&t=3&akid=7325%2E582294%2EtLnSTs)**
Chris is a Granite Stater through and through. He’s not in this for power or prestige or to cozy up to billionaires. _He’s in it to make life better for working families — the folks who get up every day, work hard, and are struggling to get by._ He’s fought Big Pharma to lower prescription drug prices, stood up for veterans, and protected reproductive rights when they’ve been under relentless attack.
Chris Pappas fights for the people — not the wealthy and well-connected. He shows up, he listens, and he gets things done. That’s what New Hampshire needs, and it’s what working people across the country need.
**But Republicans know New Hampshire is one of their best shots at flipping a Senate seat this year.** Sununu has the name recognition, the right-wing billionaire network, and the full weight of the national GOP behind him.
We’ve seen this before. Special interests will flood races with corporate money and try to buy Senators who will work for them instead of their constituents. We can’t let this happen in New Hampshire.
**If you believe, like I do, that government ought to work for working people — not the rich and powerful —[then I’m asking you to please chip in to Chris’s campaign now to help him compete and win.](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/221?c0=em_ms_cp_20260621_3.9fW3ci&refcode=em20260621-3&t=4&akid=7325%2E582294%2EtLnSTs)**
I know Chris has what it takes to win this race. But we all need to make sure he has the resources to fight back against this massive right-wing spending.
Thanks for being a part of this,
Elizabeth
**New Hampshire is poised to be one of the closest Senate races in the country. Will you chip in today to help Chris stop the Republicans from flipping the Granite State red and expanding their Senate majority?**
**[Donate »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_cp_footer?refcode=em20260621-3&t=5&refcode2=7325_582294_tLnSTs&akid=7325%2E582294%2EtLnSTs)**

body:
We only have a short window to keep on registering Arizonans before their primary election on June 22nd.
#
Peter,
Arizona’s voter registration deadline is tomorrow, and we have no time to waste.
**[Will you rush a $3 donation to Voto Latino right now to power our voter registration push across Arizona before tomorrow’s deadline?](https://act.votolatino.org/go/57?c0=em-ms-voto-20260621-1.o-ACk_&amount=3&refcode=em20260621-279&t=1&akid=279%2E1366028%2EMOZIhO)**
This year, Arizona’s election calendar shifted after Gov. Katie Hobbs signed a bipartisan bill changing the date of the 2026 primary and permanently moving future primaries. **That also moved voter registration deadlines, and some eligible voters may not realize time is already running out.**
That is why we’re working right now to register voters, share trusted voting information, and make sure our communities are ready to participate.
And we need to act fast because the stakes are high.
A Trump-aligned group recently tried to dismantle basic voting protections in Arizona counties with large Latino populations, including ballot drop boxes, signature curing for mail ballots, and standard verification practices.
**We took them to court, fought back,_and won._**
But anti-voter politicians aren’t going to stop after one loss. If they can’t suppress votes one way, they try another, through lawsuits, legislation, or gerrymandering.
That’s why we’re staying on the ground in Arizona to defend access to the ballot, register voters, mobilize our communities, and make sure Latinos show up in November.
[**So please, make a $3 donation today to help us register voters before Arizona’s deadline tomorrow and keep fighting for Latino voting power.**](https://act.votolatino.org/go/57?c0=em-ms-voto-20260621-1.o-ACk_&amount=3&%3Brefcode=em20260621-279&t=2&akid=279%2E1366028%2EMOZIhO)

Thank you,
Voto Latino

# Happy Father's Day
&
Upcoming July 4TH Amherst Parade

For those who have never read "My Dad, My Hero: My Special Tribute to My Father" I am including the link below.
_“My father was born in 1936, in a village in Sichuan, China, to an intelligent but poor and sickly father whose death left his impoverished mother to fend for herself ..._

Read the whole tribute here:
[https://x.com/Lily4Liberty/status/2068724761975308388?s=20](https://us.list-manage.com/ej_VHyUggNj?e=c338950e03&c2id=adf8b61e01be85c238f26a96cfd7c41c)

Dad is very proud of me running for Congress in New Hampshire. He even flew to the Granite State from Colorado with my younger brother and his wife to speak at my campaign kickoff rally last cycle to urge the people to support me. It meant a lot to me!

**Happy 250th Birthday America – July 4th Amherst Parade**

My campaign signed up to participate in the 250th patriotic parade in Amherst on July 4th. This is the biggest parade in NH-02 that draws many media outlets attention. We are allowed to have two cars/trucks and 50 walkers. We already registered one car and one truck, just need more walkers. Signs will be provided. Please RSVP by using the event link below and share it.

name: Citizens for Amanda Pusczek
subject: Why I'm in this fight with Amanda
body:
And why June 30th matters
---
| | | | [ View in browser](https://nkkyj.r.ag.d.sendibm3.com/mk/mr/sh/SMJz09SDriOHTaiASW5eyDMeTo5R/6MSmw0HVOuRF)
---
| | | | |
---
| | |
---
| | Friend,
My name is Greg Howard Jr., and as Co-Chair of Amanda's campaign, I get a front-row seat to what real grassroots energy looks like every single day. I see the text messages, the volunteer sign-ups, and the small-dollar contributions coming in from kitchen tables all across the district.

---
| | I’m reaching out to you today because we are just days away from a crucial milestone: our June 30th quarterly FEC deadline.
Let’s be completely honest about what happens behind closed doors in politics right now. While our opponent is sitting down with high-dollar corporate lobbyists and special-interest PACs to secure easy five-figure checks, our campaign relies entirely on neighbors like you.
When Amanda decided to run a **100% corporate PAC-free campaign** , it wasn't just a catchy slogan to us. It was a strict boundary. It means Amanda answers strictly to working-class families, not billionaires. It means we don't compromise when fighting to protect local utility rates from predatory development, and we stand unapologetically for medical privacy and bodily autonomy.
---
| | But running a grassroots campaign from the ground up means our public financial reports are heavily scrutinized by the Washington establishment. It means that they'll look at our numbers on June 30th to see if an everyday, people-powered movement can actually go head-to-head with their corporate cash machine.
---
| |
### **If everyone reading this chipped in just $5 or $10 today, we would easily smash our quarterly goal and keep our volunteers out on the trail all summer long.**
---
[**_Chip in $5 immediately to protect small-town fairness_**](https://nkkyj.r.ag.d.sendibm3.com/mk/cl/f/sh/SMK1E8tHeFuBlbHXW2Bm5gyt6pF3/s9ox39kN1T6q)
---
[**_Chip in $25 to help us fund our townhall tour infrastructure_**](https://nkkyj.r.ag.d.sendibm3.com/mk/cl/f/sh/SMK1E8tHeG13Dk6UhCLGBWHd57pJ/sk16BSoHbeI7)
---
[**_Chip in a custom amount to help Amanda win_**](https://nkkyj.r.ag.d.sendibm3.com/mk/cl/f/sh/SMK1E8tHeG7ufsvRsMUkHLaN3QPZ/3YyF29Ht_J98)
---
| | We have an opportunity to show the political establishment that North and West Alabama are not for sale. Let’s send a clear, undeniable message before the clock strikes midnight on June 30th.
Thank you for standing with us in this fight.
Onward,Greg Howard Jr. Campaign Co-Chair Amanda Pusczek for Congress

| [](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/113331?t=6&akid=25420%2E878179%2EkpMKMi) There’s a reason why far-right special interest groups are circling like vultures over Pennsylvania:

**I’m one of just two Democratic Governors running for reelection this year in a state Trump won in 2024.**

Yes, friend. One of just two in the entire country. Translation? _We’ve got the far-right’s full attention._

[Please, use this link to make a donation of any size — split between our campaign and the Voter Protection Project — before midnight. The far-right is raising lots and lots of money right now, and the only way we can fight back is with the generosity of folks like you. »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/113331?t=7&akid=25420%2E878179%2EkpMKMi)

**Team, Pennsylvania is the most competitive state in the nation — bar none.**

More often than not, our elections come down to just a few percentage points. That means just a small handful of votes could be the difference between a government that actually delivers results — or a far-right takeover of our Commonwealth.

Every decision our campaign makes, that fact is in the back of my mind. Every dollar we shift, every supporter we reach out to — every decision needs to have a purpose. Every action needs to pay off on Election Day.

**And folks, that’s exactly why I’m reaching out today.**

The truth is, these emails serve two very important purposes for our campaign. First, we want to make sure supporters like you are informed. Not only for your sake — but so you can spread the word to your friends and family as well.

Secondly — and you probably know where this is going — the money we raise from emails like these are the foundation of this entire campaign. The truth is, we’re going to need a lot of money to win this race. I’m talking about tens of millions of dollars. We’re never going to raise that amount of cash through one single email.
